sections.voiceover: Professor Martha Nussbaum earned the 2026 John W. Kluge Prize on September 22. Harvard University trained her philosophy background. Where did her doctorate lead her?
The Library of Congress awards the John W. Kluge Prize every other year.
The University of Chicago philosopher claimed the 2026 prize on September 22. Kluge Prize highlights decades exploring the human experience.
Martha Nussbaum officially claimed the prestigious 2026 prize for achievement in the study of humanity.
